actions.browse-records.description: Retrieves records from an Algolia index.
actions.browse-records.props.indexName.d: Select the Algolia index to use.
actions.browse-records.props.limit.descr: Maximum number of records to retrieve. Defaults to 10,000.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.delete-records.description: Deletes records from an Algolia index by objectID.
actions.delete-records.props.indexName.d: Select the Algolia index to use.
actions.delete-records.props.recordIds.d: Provide the Algolia objectIDs to delete from the selected index.
actions.save-records.description: Adds or updates records in an Algolia index.
actions.save-records.props.indexName.des: Enter an existing index name or a new one — Algolia creates it automatically.
actions.save-records.props.records.descr: Provide an array of JSON objects to save. Include `objectID` to update an existing record, or omit it to let Algolia create one.
auth.description:
Authenticate with your Algolia Application ID and API key.

To get your credentials:
1. Sign in to the Algolia dashboard.
2. Open **Settings > API Keys**.
3. Copy your **Application ID**.
4. Copy an API key that can list indexes and manage records.

This piece needs permissions for `listIndexes`, `browse`, `addObject`, and `deleteObject`. Search-only API keys won't work for these actions.
auth.props.apiKey.description: An Algolia API key with index browsing and record write permissions.
description: Manage your Algolia search indices — add, browse, and delete records.
